claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the lunar vicinity since 1972.
Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with astronauts aboard.
Artemis II validates the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II validates critical life-support, communication, and navigation systems with a human crew for the first time in deep space.
The crew of Artemis II will perform manual maneuvering.
The crew of Artemis II will test rendezvous capabilities.
Artemis III is planned as a crewed landing at the lunar South Pole.
Scientists will study the impact of deep-space radiation and microgravity on the crew of Artemis II.
The crew of Artemis II includes the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
The crew of Artemis II includes Christina Koch as the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II tests the performance of the heat shield during high-speed return from the Moon
